newsitem.title: UK: London gold fixes easier as PGMs dominate trade.
newsitem.headline: London gold fixes easier as PGMs dominate trade.

text.p: GOLD - Fixed at $340.70 vs $341.75 previously. In shadow of PGMs. Unmoved by fresh reassurances on German no sales policy.
SILVER - About three cents lower at $4.72/$4.74. Quiet.
PALLADIUM - Scramble for metal pushing up spot and lease rates. No sign of let up but highly volatile. $230.00/$240.00. Awaiting fresh news of Russia-Japan export talks.
